name: image-upload
description: A form field whose control is a drop target. Four states — empty, busy, attached, rejected — plus a drag-over state the component owns. Built on a real <input type="file">, so the keyboard path is the native picker rather than a re-implementation, and `browse` is a real button rather than the sheet's styled text. ImageUpload.File is one row mid-upload, drawn with a real Progress so its fill stays on the legible accent; ImageUpload.Grid and .Add are the multiple-image layout. errorText is what puts the field in `rejected`, so the message and the state cannot disagree.
